# `sam_exclusion_observations`

**SAM detailed exclusion observations**

SAM detailed exclusion observations with exact original evidence and complete native cells.

**Coverage.** Not a range. All observations of each explicitly selected public active-exclusions file. Inactive history is outside this file; absence does not establish a termination or a registration flag change. *(measured 2026-11-13)*

- **Parquet file:** `sam_exclusion_observations.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `snapshot_id` | `VARCHAR` | Digest of source kind, original capture, selected scope and explicit text encoding; not a native SAM identifier. |
| `native_id` | `VARCHAR` | Literal SAM Number for an exclusion or NoticeId for a notice. Repeated source observations remain separate. |
| `source_url` | `VARCHAR` | Original public download request. Temporary signed redirect credentials are omitted. |
| `source_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 of the retained original ZIP or CSV bytes. |
| `observed_at` | `VARCHAR` | Capture time with explicit time zone; distinct from publisher dates. |
| `snapshot_date` | `VARCHAR` | Date stated by a dated exclusions filename. NULL for the rolling notice filename, which states no snapshot date. |
| `text_encoding` | `VARCHAR` | Explicit decoding used for native CSV cells. latin-1 preserves bytes reversibly; non-ASCII interpretation remains unqualified. No guessed text repair. |
| `text_interpretation_status` | `VARCHAR` | decoded-exact or byte-preserving-unqualified. Unqualified text is diagnostic evidence, not a qualified display name or description. |
| `unqualified_text_fields_json` | `VARCHAR` | Native field names whose non-ASCII bytes lack a qualified text interpretation under Latin-1 staging. ASCII cells remain exact. |
| `member_name` | `VARCHAR` | Exact exclusions CSV ZIP member; NULL for a standalone notices CSV. |
| `member_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 of decoded original member bytes; NULL for standalone CSV. |
| `source_locator_json` | `VARCHAR` | Record ordinal and inclusive physical line range in the exact original CSV member or standalone file. |
| `raw_fields_json` | `VARCHAR` | Every native CSV column and cell, including unknown columns, quotes and multiline content. Empty CSV cells are empty strings; omitted columns differ. Reversible under text_encoding. |
| `record_content_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 of sorted literal field/cell JSON, excluding capture position; useful for source-observed refresh comparisons. |
